blurb: Skydive Adventures is a club dropzone offering tandem skydiving, student training, and experienced jumping. Tandem jumps are done with an instructor under the same parachute with minimal training. They also offer an Instructor Assisted Deployment Program for learning to skydive solo.
hoursText: Weather permitting, typically jumping on Weekends beginning around 9 am
Jumping occasionally occurs on other days and times
